intro: These terms describe what AC Repair Houston is and what it is not. We run a free referral service. We are not an AC repair contractor, we do not perform any work, and we do not have an office you can visit. By using this site you agree to the points below.

sections.p: AC Repair Houston passes requests to independent HVAC companies that cover the area you chose. We are not a contractor. There are no technicians, service vehicles or offices on our side, and nobody arrives from us. The company that takes your job is an independent business that makes its own decisions about the work and the price.

If you hire the company we refer you to, that company pays us a referral fee. You are never charged a referral fee, and we do not add a charge to your invoice. The homeowner pays the company for the work, and that is the only money the homeowner hands over.

sections.h: Your agreement is with the company
sections.p: The contract for the work is between you and the HVAC company that takes your job. That company quotes you, schedules the visit, does the work and handles any warranty on what it did. We are not a party to that agreement. We do not hold your money, we do not take payment for the work, and you never owe us anything.

The company that takes your job is responsible for holding whatever license its work requires in Texas, for carrying insurance, for the price it charges, for the parts it uses and for the quality of the work. Check its Air Conditioning Contractors license yourself in the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation license search at tdlr.texas.gov before work starts, even if the company says it is licensed.

Any estimate or quote you receive comes from the company, not from this site. We do not publish prices and we cannot give one, because we do not know what is wrong with your system or what it will take to fix. Ask for the estimate in writing, in the company's own name, and get it before the work starts. A price quoted on this site would be a guess.

We make no guarantee about anything that happens after your request leaves this site. We do not promise that a company will respond, that anyone will respond quickly, that a response will arrive at a time that suits you, or that the work will be done well. We do not vouch for any company, endorse any company, or guarantee any price, warranty or result. If you are not satisfied with the work, take it up with the company that did it, because we are not in a position to fix it for you.

sections.h: This site is provided as is
sections.p: The site is provided as it is. We try to keep the information on it accurate and the pages working, but we do not warrant that it is complete, current or free of errors, and we make no promise that it will always be available. You use it at your own risk.

The pages, the service areas, the request form and these terms can change at any time. A page you saved may say something different from what it says now. The version of these terms that applies to your use is the one published on this site when you submit your request.
